assessments.reasoning: The digest-matched GCC historical source places the GPL edition, later-version option and additional permission together in the passage beginning at byte 180.
The pinned SPDX JSON cites this file and describes GPL-2.0-or-later as typical. This is consistent context. The exact base comes from the GCC notice.

challenge.method: Test GPL-2.0-only and LGPL readings against the inline edition clause, and check whether the SPDX record requires one base for every witness.
challenge.results: The later-version option rules out the only-version reading. The header names the GPL. SPDX describes typical use and its template permits Library or Lesser wording, so extending this base to every witness would exceed the evidence.

limitations: The file establishes its own base. SPDX’s typical-use comment cannot assign that base to another file.
